# Client SDK — World, Audio, Stats, Lifecycle, Item Filter & Camera

> **Assembly:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk` · **Public types:** `18`
>
> Live `EntityManager` queries & client VFX (`IWorldService`), FMOD 2.03 2D/3D spatial audio (`IAudioService`), live entity/player stats (`IStatsService`), area transitions (`IGameLifecycle`), client item filter integration (`IItemFilterService`), and camera projection/UI coords/zoom (`ICameraService`, `TryWorldToUiPosition`).

### `ICameraService`

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/CameraTypes.cs`

Exposes read-only camera state, world-to-screen projection, world-to-UI coordinate conversion, and per-mod zoom override control.

```csharp
public interface ICameraService
```

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `CameraState GetState()` | Reads the current live in-game camera state snapshot. |
| `bool TryWorldToScreen(float worldX, float worldY, float worldZ, out float screenX, out float screenY)` | Projects a 3D world-space coordinate into 2D screen pixel coordinates. Returns: `true` if the point lies in front of an active camera; otherwise `false`. |
| `bool TryWorldToScreen(WorldPosition3D worldPosition, out float screenX, out float screenY)` | Projects a `WorldPosition3D` into 2D screen pixel coordinates. |
| `bool TryWorldToUiPosition(float worldX, float worldY, float worldZ, out float uiX, out float uiY)` | Projects a 3D world-space coordinate into Path of Exile's 1600-high virtual UI coordinate space so 3D encounter markers align pixel-accurately with `SetPosition`. Returns: `true` if the point lies in front of an active camera with a valid viewport; otherwise `false`. |
| `bool TryWorldToUiPosition(WorldPosition3D worldPosition, out float uiX, out float uiY)` | Projects a `WorldPosition3D` into Path of Exile's 1600-high virtual UI coordinate space. |
| `void SetZoomOverride(float? zoomOverride)` | Sets or clears a camera zoom override (`CameraController + 0x4ac`). Passing `null` (or a negative value) clears this mod's override and restores stock zoom (`-1.0f`). Per-mod overrides are automatically cleared when the owning mod unloads. |

### `IAudioService`

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/WorldAudioStatsLifecycle.cs`

Plays FMOD Studio events and loose/overlaid `.ogg` audio files through the client's audio manager, including 3D world-positioned audio with live camera-distance attenuation.

```csharp
public interface IAudioService
```

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |
|---|---|
| `int ActiveChannelCount { get; }` | Gets the number of currently active audio channels (client limit is 0x200). |

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `int PlayEvent(string fmodEventPath, float volume = 1.0f)` | Plays a named FMOD Studio event (for example `event:/Harvest/PlotReady`). Returns: An opaque channel handle. |
| `int PlaySoundFile(string virtualOggPath, float volume = 1.0f)` | Plays an `.ogg` audio file resolved through the client's file layer. Returns: An opaque channel handle. |
| `int PlaySoundFile(string virtualOggPath, float volume, bool loop)` | Plays an `.ogg` audio file resolved through the client's file overlay or disk with optional infinite looping. Returns: An opaque channel handle. |
| `AudioChannelHandle PlaySoundAtPosition(string pathOrEvent, float x, float y, float z, float volume = 1.0f, float maxDistance = 1200f, bool loop = false)` | Plays an FMOD event or `.ogg` sound anchored at a 3D world coordinate using live camera-distance attenuation. Automatically updated each frame on the game thread and stopped when the owning mod unloads. Returns: A strongly typed `AudioChannelHandle` for the started channel. |
| `void SetChannelPosition(AudioChannelHandle channel, float x, float y, float z, float maxDistance = 1200f)` | Updates (or attaches) the 3D world coordinate and attenuation radius of an active audio channel, immediately re-evaluating its distance-attenuated gain against the live camera/listener position. |
| `void SetChannelVolume(int channelHandle, float volume)` | Updates the linear volume (0.0 to 1.0) of an active audio channel. |
| `bool IsChannelPlaying(int channelHandle)` | Returns `true` while the specified audio channel is actively playing. |
| `void StopChannel(int channelHandle)` | Stops an active audio channel by handle. |

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/WorldAudioStatsLifecycle.cs`

Reads client stats and sets display-only local stats (synchronously notifying client listeners). Local stat writes are invisible to the server and overwritten on the next server sync.

```csharp
public interface IStatsService
```

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `int GetStat(string statKey, int defaultValue = 0)` | Reads a client stat by key, returning `defaultValue` if unset. |
| `void SetLocalStat(string statKey, int value)` | Sets a display-only local stat and notifies any registered listeners. |
| `IDisposable OnStatChanged(string statKey, Action<int> listener)` | Subscribes to changes for a specific stat key. |
| `int ReadStat(uint entityId, int statId)` | Reads a live numeric stat (`StatsComponent`) on the given world entity, returning `0` if absent or unavailable. Passing `0` for `entityId` reads from the local player entity. |

| `IReadOnlyDictionary<int, int> GetLocalPlayerStats()` | Enumerates all numeric stats on the local player entity (convenience alias for `GetAllStats(uint)` with `entityId = 0`). |

### `WorldEntityKind`

**Kind:** `enum` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/WorldAudioStatsLifecycle.cs` · **Attributes:** `[Flags]`

Component and classification flags describing a live world entity in the active client area.

```csharp
public enum WorldEntityKind: uint
```

**Values:**

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| `None = 0u` | No classification flags set. |
| `Player = 1u << 0` | Entity has a `Player` component. |
| `Monster = 1u << 1` | Entity is a monster or combat actor. |
| `WorldItem = 1u << 2` | Entity is a ground loot drop with a `WorldItem` component. |
| `Chest = 1u << 3` | Entity has a `Chest` component. |
| `Npc = 1u << 4` | Entity has an `NPC` component. |
| `Portal = 1u << 5` | Entity has a `Portal` component. |
| `AreaTransition = 1u << 6` | Entity has an `AreaTransition` component. |
| `MinimapIcon = 1u << 7` | Entity has a `MinimapIcon` component. |
| `Targetable = 1u << 8` | Entity is currently targetable by the player. |
| `Alive = 1u << 9` | Entity has a `Life` component with current HP > 0. |
| `Opened = 1u << 10` | Chest or transitionable entity is already opened. |
| `LocalPlayer = 1u << 11` | Entity is the local player entity. |
| `ClientOnly = 1u << 12` | Entity was spawned locally on the client (`EntityId >= 0x40000000`). |

| `void PlayEffect(uint targetObjectId, string effectPath)` | Queues a visual effect on a target object. |
| `WorldEntitySnapshot? GetLocalPlayer()` | Returns a snapshot of the local player entity in the current area, or `null` when not in-game. |
| `IReadOnlyList<WorldEntitySnapshot> GetEntities(WorldEntityQuery? query = null)` | Queries live entities in the current area's `EntityManager`, optionally filtered by `query`. |
| `WorldEntitySnapshot? GetEntity(uint entityId)` | Looks up a single live entity by its world entity id, or returns `null` if absent. |
| `IReadOnlyList<WorldEntitySnapshot> GetWorldItems(bool filterVisibleOnly = false, float? maxDistance = null)` | Returns all ground `WorldItem` entities in the current area, optionally filtering by item-filter visibility and distance from the local player. |
| `WorldPosition3D? GetEntityPosition(uint entityId)` | Returns the current 3D world position of the specified entity, or `null` if not found. |

### `AreaInfo`

**Kind:** `record` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/WorldAudioStatsLifecycle.cs`

Rich metadata snapshot describing the currently loaded game area (`WorldAreasRow` + `ClientWorld`).

```csharp
public sealed record AreaInfo(string AreaId, string AreaName, int Act, int AreaLevel, int EffectiveLevel, ushort Hash16, bool IsTown, bool IsHideout, bool IsGuildHideout, IReadOnlyList<uint> ActiveRulesetIds, uint AreaSeed = 0)
```

**Parameters / Properties:**

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `string AreaId` | Unique `WorldAreas.Id` string (for example `1_1_town`). |
| `string AreaName` | Localized display name of the area (for example `Lioneye's Watch`). |
| `int Act` | Act number (`WorldAreasRow + 0x10`). |
| `int AreaLevel` | Base area level from `WorldAreasRow + 0x26`. |
| `int EffectiveLevel` | Effective runtime monster/area level from `ClientWorld + 0xd4`. |
| `ushort Hash16` | 16-bit area hash (`WorldAreasRow + 0x2a`). |
| `bool IsTown` | `true` if the area is a town. |
| `bool IsHideout` | `true` if the area is a player hideout. |
| `bool IsGuildHideout` | `true` if the area is a guild hideout. |
| `IReadOnlyList<uint> ActiveRulesetIds` | Active ruleset identifiers reported by `InstanceClient` for this instance. |
| `uint AreaSeed = 0` | Deterministic area generation seed from `ClientWorld + 0x8e0`, if available. |

### `IGameLifecycle`

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/WorldAudioStatsLifecycle.cs`

Core client lifecycle events dispatched on the game thread.

```csharp
public interface IGameLifecycle
```

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |
|---|---|
| `long FrameCount { get; }` | Total number of frames processed since host initialization. |
| `bool IsConnected { get; }` | Gets whether the client is currently connected to an instance server. |
| `string? CurrentAreaId { get; }` | Gets the active area id, or `null` when outside an area. |
| `AreaInfo? CurrentArea { get; }` | Gets the full metadata snapshot of the active game area, or `null` when outside an area. |

**Events:**

| Event | Summary |
|---|---|
| `event Action<float>? Frame` | Raised once per frame on the game thread with elapsed delta seconds. |
| `event Action<AreaEventArgs>? AreaEntered` | Raised when the client finishes entering an area. |
| `event Action<string>? AreaLeft` | Raised when the client leaves an area. |
| `event Action? Connected` | Raised when an instance server connection is established. |
| `event Action<string?>? Disconnected` | Raised when disconnected from the server, with an optional reason. |
